name: What are the advantages of selecting a pre-construction unit early?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of selecting a pre-construction unit early?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selecting a pre-construction unit early offers several advantages, including the best selection of units, premium views, and the opportunity for early-buyer incentives or preferred pricing. Early buyers also often have more flexibility regarding customization options for finishes and upgrades. In competitive markets like Brickell or Downtown Miami, securing a unit early can provide access to floor plans and locations that become unavailable quickly as sales progress.
acceptedAnswer.description: Early selection provides better unit choice, premium views, potential incentives, and more customization options.
